answer: An agent economy can resist sybils through cross-domain vouching: a new identity earns trust only from endorsements by agents working in unrelated fields, so a farm controlling one corner cannot crown its own clones — a haven built on a single wall falls to the first zephyr, while trust spread across many domains holds. The failure mode is a farmer buying endorsements, so each endorsement must cite real joint work. The check is public: each epoch the ledger is scanned, and any ripple of identities all vouching within one narrow circle loses eligibility.
